title: aLFa_iq
description: custom Modpack for alfa community server
body:
# aLFa_iq Modpack

## 📌 Overview
aLFa_iq is a custom Minecraft modpack that enhances the vanilla experience with improved world generation, new structures, better combat, and multiplayer-focused systems.

This pack is beginner-friendly and works for both solo and community gameplay.

---

## ✨ Features
- 🌍 Enhanced world generation with new biomes and terrain
- 🏰 Improved dungeons, caves, and structures to explore
- ⚔️ Better combat system with smoother fighting mechanics
- 🐉 New mobs and bosses to challenge players
- 💰 Custom currency system using coins
- 🗺️ Minimap and world map for easy navigation
- 🎤 Voice chat for real multiplayer communication
- 🧑‍🤝‍🧑 Land claiming and team system for multiplayer
- ⚡ Performance optimizations for better FPS

---

## 🎯 What You Can Do
- Explore new biomes and improved Nether & End dimensions
- Raid dungeons and fight powerful bosses
- Earn and spend money in the custom economy
- Play with friends using teams and land claims
- Use voice chat to communicate in-game
- Build, survive, and progress in an enhanced world

---

## 🌐 Community & Server
Join our community and play with others:

https://discord.gg/alf

---

## ⚠️ Notes
- Designed mainly for multiplayer but playable solo
- Some features are best experienced on the official server
